Definition: to be (causatively, make) triplicate (by restoration, in portions, strands, days or years)
BiblicalUsage: Three is the number this word makes, and it appears where things are done in threes. Elijah poured water on the altar the third time until it ran down, God told Abram to take a heifer of three years old for the covenant, and the Preacher says a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe three is God's number for strength, because a cord of three strands holds where two would part.
